title: Signed factorial inverse identity
statement:
For natural numbers $j$ and $k$ with $k\le j$, the following identity holds over the real numbers:
$$(-1)^k\frac{1}{k!}\frac{1}{(j-k)!}(-1)^{j-k}=(-1)^j\binom{j}{k}\frac{1}{j!}.$$
